simple.summary: חַדְרָךְ (Chadrâk) means Chadrak , a Syrian deity First listed occurrence: Zech 9 1.

definitions.full: H2317. Chadrak חַדְרָ֔ךְ proper name, of a territory only Zech 9:1 ח ׳אֶרֶץ (|| דַּמֶּשֶׂק ); perhaps = Assyrian –atarakka, –atari(k)ka, a district near Damascus and Hamath; see Schr COT on the passage , Dl Pa 279 .
